PaymentService/Get.sync_payment: Adyen has no status-by-transaction-ID endpoint for a plain (non-redirect) card payment — confirmed against hyperswitch main's adyen connector, which returns None from build_request for PSync without encoded_data and relies on webhooks instead. UCS has no local order state to fall back on, so this scenario cannot pass for card.
PaymentService/Get.sync_payment_with_handle_response: same as sync_payment — no PSync endpoint exists for a non-redirect card payment on Adyen.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_collect: UPI is not in supported_payment_methods for this certification pass (card only). PaymentService/Get's scenarios carry no payment_method field for the harness's supported_payment_methods filter to key on (unlike Authorize's scenarios), so this UPI-only scenario is not automatically excluded and needs an explicit entry here.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_intent: out of scope for this certification pass — see sync_upi_collect.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_qr: out of scope for this certification pass — see sync_upi_collect.
